title: E-side identity equations for the integral finite-extension comparison
statement: For fixed E, dualizing datum wE and normalized tensor presentation a satisfying first-variable evaluation naturality, the prescribed integral finite-extension maps satisfy IdentityConclusion for E [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core].

proof.text: Apply the uniqueness clause of u_existsUnique to the specified multiplication unit. Its finite squares are unit_dualizing_reduction at every n; hence the chosen integral u equals this unit.

Use injectivity of the inverse tensor-Hom adjunction. First-variable evaluation naturality and counit naturality uncurry Hom of the inverse first-variable unit and the target unit. The defining transpose of homMap and scalarTensor_identity identify the uncurried map with evaluation after the unit on Hom. Cancel the completion isomorphisms by functoriality to obtain exactly the v equation.

Expand beta as v followed by Hom into u. Substitute the first equation. Functoriality combines Hom into the dualizing unit with Hom of the inverse source unit into one product map. Apply the v equation with M=wE.omega to obtain the beta equation.

theorem comparison_identity_E
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (wE : DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (_hevalE : ∀ (K K' M : IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X) (f : K' ⟶ K),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
          ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)).map
            (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 M)))) ≫ (a.adjunction K').counit.app M =
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (a.adjunction K).counit.app M) :
    IdentityConclusion l E X D hl wE a
